content: वैशेषिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Characteristic, special; विषये वर्तमानानां यं तं वैशेषिकैर्गुणैः (प्राहुर्विषयगोप्तारम्) <ls>Mb. 12. 47. 70</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">7. 5. 15</ls>. .²2 Belonging to the Vaiśeṣika doctrine. .{@-कः@} A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine. .{@-कम्@} [विशेषं पदार्थभेदमधिकृत्य कृतो ग्रन्थः ठञ्] One of the six principal Darśanas or systems of Hindu philosophy founded by Kaṇāda; it differs from the Nyāya philosophy of Gautama in that it recognizes only seven instead of sixteen categories or heads of predicables (the earlier writers {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} Kaṇāda recognizing only six), and lays particular stress upon Viśeṣa.
